1.web: Remind them to be in subjection to rulers and to authorities, to be obedient, to be ready for every good work,
1.asv: Put them in mind to be in subjection to rulers, to authorities, to be obedient, to be ready unto every good work,

2.web: to speak evil of no one, not to be contentious, to be gentle, showing all humility toward all men.
2.asv: to speak evil of no man, not to be contentious, to be gentle, showing all meekness toward all men.

3.web: For we were also once foolish, disobedient, deceived, serving various lusts and pleasures, living in malice and envy, hateful, and hating one another.
3.asv: For we also once were foolish, disobedient, deceived, serving divers lusts and pleasures, living in malice and envy, hateful, hating one another.

4.web: But when the kindness of God our Savior and his love toward mankind appeared,
4.asv: But when the kindness of God our Saviour, and his love toward man, appeared,

5.web: not by works of righteousness, which we did ourselves, but according to his mercy, he saved us, through the washing of regeneration and renewing by the Holy Spirit,
5.asv: not by works done in righteousness, which we did ourselves, but according to his mercy he saved us, through the washing of regeneration and renewing of the Holy Spirit,

6.web: whom he poured out on us richly, through Jesus Christ our Savior;
6.asv: which he poured out upon us richly, through Jesus Christ our Saviour;

7.web: that, being justified by his grace, we might be made heirs according to the hope of eternal life.
7.asv: that, being justified by his grace, we might be made heirs according to the hope of eternal life.

8.web: This saying is faithful, and concerning these things I desire that you affirm confidently, so that those who have believed God may be careful to maintain good works. These things are good and profitable to men;
8.asv: Faithful is the saying, and concerning these things I desire that thou affirm confidently, to the end that they who have believed God may be careful to maintain good works. These things are good and profitable unto men:

9.web: but shun foolish questionings, genealogies, strife, and disputes about the law; for they are unprofitable and vain.
9.asv: but shun foolish questionings, and genealogies, and strifes, and fightings about the law; for they are unprofitable and vain.

10.web: Avoid a factious man after a first and second warning;
10.asv: A factious man after a first and second admonition refuse;

11.web: knowing that such a one is perverted, and sins, being self-condemned.
11.asv: knowing that such a one is perverted, and sinneth, being self-condemned.

12.web: When I send Artemas to you, or Tychicus, be diligent to come to me to Nicopolis, for I have determined to winter there.
12.asv: When I shall send Artemas unto thee, or Tychicus, give diligence to come unto me to Nicopolis: for there I have determined to winter.

13.web: Send Zenas, the lawyer, and Apollos on their journey speedily, that nothing may be lacking for them.
13.asv: Set forward Zenas the lawyer and Apollos on their journey diligently, that nothing be wanting unto them.

14.web: Let our people also learn to maintain good works for necessary uses, that they may not be unfruitful.
14.asv: And let our people also learn to maintain good works for necessary uses, that they be not unfruitful.

15.web: All who are with me greet you. Greet those who love us in faith. Grace be with you all. Amen.
15.asv: All that are with me salute thee. Salute them that love us in faith. Grace be with you all.
